# Calhoun School

> > Calhoun School is a progressive PreK-12 independent school on NYC's Upper West Side combining Montessori principles with STEAM education and project-based learning.

Founded 125 years ago, Calhoun School serves families across Manhattan with a student-centered, progressive educational philosophy emphasizing diversity, equity, and innovative learning. The school operates multiple campuses and maintains a vibrant alumni community known as Cougar Nation.

## Key Topics
